limits: Token-enabled durable API sends now reserve estimated allowance; monetary reservations and CLI physical provenance remain pending.
Concurrent planned token allowance is reserved atomically for covered API sends. Input estimates and opaque history prevent a hard provider-token or invoice cap claim.
Checkpoint-relative stream deltas are verified offline; exact CLI request provenance, idless observations and pre-delivery crash gaps remain incomplete.
Simulation aggregate model labels retain stable identity; detailed model diagnostics are separate.
Imported historical baselines are opaque and legacy marker-first ambiguity is explicit.
Unknown/cache partition coverage is not inferred; usage_complete remains false.

Backend and factory-instrumented nonstreaming CAMEL physical attempts, unresolved recovery and token reservations are verified offline; monetary reservations, CLI physical failures and custom SDK replacement remain incomplete.

Enabled budget guards use a verified narrow projection; token sums remain O(delta rows), and cost grouping is retained for exact rounding compatibility. No default-disabled or production speedup claim.

Native factory requests remain uncapped by default and are rejected before send if token reservations are enabled. An explicit native output policy now reaches actual factory/child requests and is pinned per simulation; held allowance stays separate from recorded usage.
